programmes.d: As jet skiers threaten the safety of the surfers in the water, personal turmoil rages on the beach.
Cody, JD, and Lani try to make some extra cash collecting Sea Urchins to sell in the Far East.
Garner Ellerbee returns and enlists Mitch’s help to track down a ring of offshore drug smugglers.
Cody makes a bet with some hotshots and Mitch ends up in a wild race with a finish no one expected.
After a swimmer shows symptoms of a deadly virus, headquarters is quarantined.
Neely's new nanny develops a deadly obsession with Mitch after he saves her from a boating disaster.
Hobie's good fortune lands him, Mitch, Cody and a jewel thief aboard a cruise ship to Alaska.
During a stop in Juneau, Leslie takes a clueless Hobie on the beginning a harrowing chase.
After rescuing a glacier-bound Hobie, Mitch returns with a romantic proposition for Neely.
Cody and April's plane crashes during a storm. Meanwhile Mitch's new life with Neely falls apart.
Mitch deals with Neely's confession as Cody and April race to save the survivors of the plane crash.
The conniving CEO of a private lifeguard company wants to take over Baywatch to expand her company.
Cody and Alex take her nephew to swim with dolphins in Hawaii, where Cody meets with Lani's sister.
A mysterious lifeguard begins making rescues around Baywatch but vanishes before being caught.
Jessie runs into an old beau who could destroy her future at Baywatch.
Hobie struggles with his role in a boating accident that left a girl in a coma.
Mitch befriends a young boy who joins the junior lifeguards in hopes of escaping a brutal home life.
Mitch, despondent from his failed marriage to Neely, goes for a day-long tower swim along the beach.
Mitch and Alex protect an orangutan, while Cody and Jessie deal with its abusive owner.
Cody puts his career, and life, on the line when he starts using a performance-enhancing supplement.
Mitch reunites an Army parachutist with her father, while Cody helps a free-diver reach a new "low.”
Mitch ends up on the wrong side of the law after he tries to save Tanner from his abusive father.
Craig tells Mitch a shocking secret. Jessie tries to end JD and Cody's rivalry during a triathlon.
Mitch feels the need for speed when Tanner's cousin, Damon, a race car driver, visits Baywatch.
Mitch's lifeguard buddy's ex-wife dies in Australia so the team joins him on a trip down under.
While team Baywatch prepares to compete against the Australian lifeguards.
Cody learns a lesson in love when he and Mitch help a violinist escape her dangerous mentor.
Alex tries to save a diamond smuggler whose partners want him to "sleep with the fishes."
After Manny suffers a life-altering injury during a rescue, April tries to save him from himself.
April and Jessie search for the perfect celebrity host for a seaside beauty contest.
